segments.text:
V. 21.
Lord of heaven and earth—In both of which thy Kingdom ſtands, and that of Satan is deſtroyed. That thou haſt hid theſe things—He rejoiced not in the Deſtruction of the Wiſe and Prudent, but in the Diſplay of the Riches of GOD's Grace to others, in ſuch a Manner as reſerves to Him the entire Glory of our Salvation, and hides Pride from Man.
